title: Peubisik Meuh di Padang pasir .
intro: Bayangkan saboh kemah padang pasir nyang luah lam siat preh dan hana pasti. Sidroe peumimpén nyang rayeuk ka geujak meurumpok ngon Ilahi, geutinggai saboh masyarakat nyang meuheut keu sapeue-sapeue nyang meuwujud keu geumat. Lam jeuda nyang hana teuntram nyan, sidroe tokoh nyang persuasif jijak ukeu ngon janji-janji nyang meusinar dan saboh ciptaan nyang carong nyang deuh jih udep.
clues: Lon na lam kawan ureuëng-ureuëng njang tinggai Meusé deungon Musa, saksi laôt meupisah keu peuleupah droëteuh.
Lon kalon watee pemimpin geutanyoe geujak u gunong peut ploh malam untuk geuterimong bimbingan.
Lon peusapat hiasan nibak rakyat dan lon bentuk ngon jaroe lon keudroe.
Lon peugot saboh aneuk leumo nyang jibri su nyang meu-ulang-ulang, dan lon hôi rakyat keu aneuëk nyan.
Lon cok saboh jaroe abe dari jeujak utusan nyan dan lon boh lam peu nyang lon peugot.
Lon dihadapkan le Musa dan dikutuk untuk peugah ‘bek neusentuh lon’ dan udep meupisah, deungon rapat nyang dijanjikan untuk hukoman.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
